header: Generated by workflow reverse-to-zero-v2; exploratory (tier X) unless stated; M0 is a hypothesis change, not a derivation.

registration.no_data_loaded_statement: This script and registration.json were produced from file names, os.stat sizes, and text-file quote checks only. No FITS, CSV, covariance, catalogue or timing file was opened.
registration.amendment_rule: registration.json is frozen at its commit. Any later change goes in registration_amendment_<n>.json with its own commit and is reported as a deviation; a threshold typed into an analysis script is not pre-registered.

X1.if_gate_fails: No p-values. M0 outcome: NOT TESTED.
X1.if_p_corr_ge_0.05: Gaussian null NOT rejected: M0's Gaussian prediction is consistent with the map at the sensitivity established by the string power table. Not evidence for M0 over alternatives; no K3xT2 statement.
X1.if_p_corr_lt_0.05: The spectrum-matched Gaussian null is rejected by that statistic for that map and pipeline. Causes not separable: non-Gaussianity, foreground/ILC residual, mask leakage, or a null-model defect. Reported as an anomaly, not as a failure of M0 and not as support for any alternative. A rejection in WMAP but not in SMICA (or vice versa) is reported as such.

X2.gate_pass_and_p_corr_ge_0.05: not rejected: the data topology at R_s = 20 Mpc/h is consistent with the lognormal redshift-space null (which encodes Gaussian initial conditions with linear bias, i.e. M0's frozen-LCDM assumptions).
X2.gate_pass_and_p_corr_lt_0.05: the null is rejected at R_s = 20 Mpc/h. This is a statement about the mock model (lognormal + linear bias + FoG) at least as much as about M0; no attribution to K3xT2 or to any alternative.
X2.note: any excess at r < 20 Mpc/h is outside the validated range and cannot enter a verdict

decision_rules_verbatim_by_test.X3: Report |c4| < x at 95% (x from the Fieller interval) as a bound, or 'no bound', or ABSENT. M0 (c4 = 0) is 'consistent with' the data iff 0 lies inside the interval. No statement that M0 or K3xT2 predicts c4.

thresholds_for_context_only.source: PRE_REGISTRATION.md threshold table, recomputed with scipy here; it is a table, not a rule for this comparison

X4.reporting: X4 reports Delta chi2, the p-value and sigma for each comparison, primary (1580) and disclosed (1590) cuts, and says 'DR2, informational for PRE_REGISTRATION P1; not a P1 verdict'. Words such as 'falsified' or 'confirmed' are not used. Because the CMB priors are an approximation, X4 also states that the published DR2 combination (PRE_REGISTRATION R4, 3.1 sigma with the full CMB likelihood) is not re-analysed here.
X4.for_M0: M0 vs Lambda: Delta chi2 with 1 dof; M0 'not rejected' if p >= 0.05, else 'disfavoured relative to fitted Lambda at that DR2 combination', still no P1 verdict.

framing_lens.summary: Three genuine ground-rule-7 quotation defects (V1 high, V2 medium, V4 low) plus one 'invented-registration-phrasing' defect (V3, high) were found in the hand-written Markdown of X3-pta/README.md and X4-bao-cmb-sn/X4_RESULT.md -- none in the machine-generated quotes_verbatim JSON blocks, which is exactly where round 1's defect class would recur if it recurred: free-form prose, not the scripted grep-assert path. A fifth issue (V5) is a factual mismatch between X2-cosmic-web/REPORT.md's self-described seed deviation and the actual committed x2_lib.py code (the code uses the registered seed 20260920; the report claims 20260919 was used instead, backwards from what registration.json permits). None of the five findings changes any experiment's headline verdict (X1: WMAP null not rejected p_corr=0.472, SMICA anomaly p_corr=0.004; X2: INCONCLUSIVE, gate calibration fails; X3: CONDITIONAL, no unconditional bound; X4: informational for P1, CPL-vs-Lambda ~2.1-2.2 sigma) -- all four verdicts are independently reproduced from the committed numeric JSON and stand. Framing rules 5, 8, 9, 10, 11 are otherwise respected cleanly across all four experiments: no K3xT2-predicts language, both P1s consistently distinguished and named, 'pre-registered' never misused, DR2 never given a P1 verdict, and no upgrading of 'not rejected' into 'confirms'.

X1-cmb-tda-reverse-zero-r2.reason: Not rerun (needs gitignored FITS maps and a multi-hour, multi-GB null-sim regeneration under the memory-safety/foreground rule; not attempted, marked NOT ATTEMPTED for this review's budget rather than assumed). Verified instead by loading the committed gate.json/result.json artifacts directly: per-band gate thresholds and z-scores confirmed for both maps (item 4), Sidak p_corr formula independently recomputed and matched to 5 decimal places for both WMAP (0.4722) and SMICA (0.00400), and the registered decision rule (WMAP not-rejected, SMICA anomaly-with-causes-not-separable, no cross-map pooling, no K3xT2 statement) matches registration.json's text and was applied as written. One correction is entered against X1's own caveat text: its 'var_ratio_sim_over_data' explanation for the SMICA anomaly (finding F1) is inconsistent with the script's own per-map variance normalization (four_curves() divides every map, sim or data, by its own std before thresholding), so that specific causal candidate should be read as unsupported, not as a validated partial cause. This is a correction to a caveat, not a defect in the computed p_corr=0.004 itself, and the registered rule's own wording already caps the SMICA finding at 'an anomaly with causes not separable' -- so the verdict (WMAP not rejected; SMICA anomaly, no K3xT2 statement) stands as reported.

X2-cosmic-web-round2.reason: Not rerun (needs a gitignored galaxy CSV and an 1130-mock CAMB+lognormal ensemble in a mocks/ directory the experiment itself gitignores as regenerable bulk; not attempted). Verified by direct code read against registration.json: gate power (poisson_reject_rate=0.995 CI[0.972,0.9999], x3_reject_rate=0.985 CI[0.957,0.997], both clear of the required >=0.95, confirmed via x2_analyze.py's own binomtest computation, not just the summary number); F=[8,20) (bins 0:3) and G=[20,60) (bins 3:13) are disjoint by construction (x2_lib.py's RS_EDGES=np.arange(8.0,60.01,4.0)); the 10x10 G-range covariance uses the standard Hartlap factor (NF-p-2)/(NF-1); redshift-space treatment is linear Kaiser displacement along the line of sight plus a sigma_v=4 Mpc/h Gaussian FoG term (x2_lib.py line 344), matching the registered null_model. The registered decision rule stops at INCONCLUSIVE once the calibration gate fails (data chi2=40.21 vs threshold 20.18, p=0.004), and that is exactly what was reported -- no topology p-value was allowed to override it. One item worth flagging without escalating: an informational topology p_corr=0.34 was computed anyway after the gate failure, which sits close to the registered wording 'Gate calibration fails ... INCONCLUSIVE, no topology p'; it was explicitly labeled a post-hoc, informational deviation and excluded from the verdict, so it does not change INCONCLUSIVE either way, but a stricter reading would have omitted computing it at all.

X3-pta-c4_pta_product-nanograv15yr.reason: Not rerun (requires /mnt/disks/disk-socrateai-local-1/venv-pta, a separate venv entirely outside this git repo with enterprise/enterprise_extensions/PINT installed, plus cached PINT Pulsar objects outside the worktree; not reproducible from a clean clone of the worktree alone, not attempted). The P4-term definition and the optimal-statistic normalization both check out: x3_combine.py's P4(xi)=(35cos^4-30cos^2+3)/8 is textually the same Legendre-4 polynomial as param_loop_sim.py's l4_response, on the same cos(pulsar-pair-angle) argument, and the b_hat/a_hat ratio construction correctly recovers c4_pta_product=c4_c0_ratio*pta_suppression given that param_loop_sim's implicit HD coefficient is 1; the OS reimplementation matches enterprise_extensions.OptimalStatistic.compute_os to machine precision on an independent 3-pulsar subset (x3_verify_os_result.json, 0.0 relative difference in rho/sig/xi). Under this lens's own checklist item 3 ('registered rule applied exactly'), the pair covariance is where it fails: the registration names 'the Allen 2023 Variance of the Hellings-Downs correlation formalism' by name, and a delete-one-pulsar jackknife covariance was substituted instead (confirmed absent from enterprise_extensions 3.0.3 by the experiment's own grep) -- a disclosed but real departure from the registered statistic, not a disclosed slack within it. Two further registered elements were also unmet: the calibration_gates.hd_recovery statistic asks for a 1-parameter HD-only fit with c4 fixed at 0, but what is reported is a_hat from the joint 2-parameter (a,b) GLS fit; and the CURN amplitude the whole fit is conditioned on (log10_A_CURN) was never fetched or verified against the NANOGrav 15-yr paper. All three are honestly disclosed, and the experiment's own CONDITIONAL / no-unconditional-bound framing is the right way to report a result built this way -- the writeup is not the problem. But 'the registered rule was applied exactly,' which is what this checklist item asks, does not hold for X3's central covariance and gate statistic, so stands=false under this lens.

X4-bao-cmb-sn.reason: Independently reproduced in a clean git clone (git clone of the worktree at 7bc2688, plus a manual copy of the one file .gitignore excludes, data/real2/dark_energy/Pantheon+SH0ES_STAT+SYS.cov, sha256-verified identical to the worktree's copy). Ran x4_bao_cmb_sn.py fit --cut 1580 for all three models (m0, lcdm, cpl) with 6 of the registered 20 seeded starts (start-lo 0 --start-hi 6, same default_rng(9000000+i) seed formula) and all six starts per model converged to the recorded chi2_min: m0=1408.955 (recorded 1408.955), lcdm=1404.2795 (recorded 1404.28), cpl=1397.2808 (recorded 1397.281) -- including independently reproducing the disclosed anomaly that CPL start index 3 lands on a distinct higher local minimum (chi2=1526.7261 here). The CMB distance-prior table and its inverse covariance were grep-verified verbatim against the tracked, fetched arXiv:1808.05724 TeX source (all three central values and all six independent inverse-covariance entries matched to every printed digit). The single SN-cut function, the Wilks dof choice (2 for CPL-vs-Lambda, 1 for M0-vs-Lambda), and every reported sigma were independently recomputed with scipy and matched to 3+ decimal places. No defect found.

cross_lens_disagreement.X3: framing lens does not mark X3's headline CONDITIONAL/no-bound framing as a violation (its own quote defects V1/V2/V4 don't change the numeric verdict); statistics lens marks stands=false because the registered test (Allen-2023 covariance, c4=0-fixed hd_recovery, verified CURN amplitude) was not the one performed. Both are correct on their own checklist items; this ledger records both rather than averaging them.
